input: Find special needs, autism, disability and inclusive summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville special needs autism summer camp 2026 2025
We Rock Spectrum Asheville summer camp 2026

candidates.name: We Rock the Spectrum Asheville
candidates.note: Inclusive sensory-gym summer camp; 2026 themed programs ideal for ages 3–7.

candidates.name: Asheville Jewish Community Center
candidates.note: Camp Ruach and autism-inclusive Camp Tikvah; Ruach's summer 2027 opening is announced.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Therapeutic recreation summer camps plus general youth camps at multiple city centers; 2027 details due February 1.

candidates.name: Christmount
candidates.note: Camp Lakey Gap offers weeklong residential autism camps for children and teens with 1:1 or 1:2 support.

candidates.name: Talisman Camps
candidates.note: Overnight adventure camps for ages 6–22 with autism, ADHD or learning differences; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Camp Ability of WNC
candidates.note: Two-week summer day program for ages 6–18 with disabilities, buddy support and physical or medical accommodations.

candidates.name: SOAR
candidates.note: North Carolina overnight adventure programs for youth with ADHD and learning differences.

candidates.name: Morganton Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: Offered a one-day IDAP! camp for individuals with disabilities on July 21, 2026, alongside youth summer camps.

candidates.name: Greenville County Parks, Recreation & Tourism
candidates.note: Camp Spearhead offers eight weeklong residential sessions for campers with disabilities ages 8 and older.

candidates.name: We Rock Asheville
candidates.note: Music camp for girls and nonbinary youth ages 8–16 of all abilities; 2026 camp held at ArtSpace Charter School.
